## Linked task and Agentile work package

Issue URL and WP:

## Change and trust classification

State the intended behavior, affected repositories and compatibility impact. Identify governance, workflow, credential, deployment or physical-safety changes.

## Evidence

Exact head SHA, actual checks/interfaces exercised, results and remaining limits. Distinguish fixtures from live/installed evidence. Do not include credentials or private raw payloads.

## Independent acceptance and recovery

Reviewer identity, rollback/compensation limits, dependent PRs and integration-pin change. Verify exact closing-issue references before merge.
